question: Batch Size=1 vs 8时的TTFT（Time To First Token）差异量化：TTFT主要由Prefill阶段决定，Batching对Prefill的加速比有限（受限于KV Cache分配和调度开销），预计Batch=8时TTFT仅比Batch=1降低10-20%，而TPOT（Time Per Output Token）在Batch=8时可能因显存带宽竞争增加20-40%，需实测input=2k/output=1k场景下的P50/P95延迟

sources.title: Metrics | NVIDIA NIM Benchmarking Documentation
sources.snippet: Figure 1. Overview of popular LLM inference performance metrics. Time to First Token Time to first token (TTFT) measures how long you wait before seeing the model's output. It is the time from query submission to the first received token, if the response is not empty.
